info.name: Bizora Pilot API
info.description: Inventory, sales and installments. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner): each request saves the IDs the next ones need. Uses a fresh shop each run, so it can be repeated. Set baseUrl to your API (default http://localhost:3000/api/v1).

item.name: 0. Setup
item.description: Creates a shop, logs in the owner, creates an employee and signs them in.

exec: pm.test('2 units, AVAILABLE', () => { const u = pm.response.json().units; pm.expect(u.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(u[0].status).to.eql('AVAILABLE'); });

item.name: Rejected: duplicate serial (case and spaces ignored)
Employee sells a unit at full price
Employee sells a unit on installment
Owner: filter full-price sales by employee

exec: pm.test('collected = full price + down + installments', () => { const c = pm.response.json().summary.collected; pm.expect(c.totalCents).to.eql(c.fullPriceCents + c.downPaymentsCents + c.installmentPaymentsCents); });

item.name: Other shop cannot read our unit
Other shop cannot read our sale
Other shop cannot sell our unit
Owner refunds a sale (reason required, audit-logged)
Owner promotes the employee to manager

exec: pm.test('manager role with operational defaults', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.employee.accessRole).to.eql('manager'); pm.expect(b.permissions.effective).to.include('sales.viewAll'); pm.expect(b.permissions.effective).to.not.include('inventory.viewCost'); });

item.name: Manager sees every sale in the shop
Manager cannot record an installment payment by default
Manager cannot change permissions (own or others)
Owner grants installment collection to the manager
Owner reads the permission picture and history

exec: pm.test('history has the grant and the promotion', () => { const h = pm.response.json().history.map(x => x.action); pm.expect(h).to.include('MANAGER_PERMISSIONS_CHANGED'); pm.expect(h).to.include('EMPLOYEE_PROMOTED'); });
pm.test('employee again, overrides cleared', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.employee.accessRole).to.eql('employee'); pm.expect(b.permissions.overrides.allow).to.eql([]); });

item.name: Demoted manager no longer sees the team
